text.sourceText: There are plenty of things to do in the Philippines, but among social activities one of the most popular, especially to those who live in or near large cities, is going to the mall. Sure, shopping at the local palengke, or market, can be a great cultural experience, but for many urban Filipinos the local mall is the place to be. Malls have replaced the Spanish-built plazas as the central gathering spots for the community, and they attract both tourists and locals. Everything can be found there, from chic art galleries and expensive restaurants to discount stores. And where else can Filipinos escape the intense humidity and the seasonal typhoons than in nicely air-conditioned, water-tight facilities?
text.id: Ada banyak hal yang harus dilakukan di Filipina, tapi di antara kegiatan sosial yang paling populer, terutama bagi mereka yang tinggal di kota atau dekat kota besar, akan pergi ke mal tentu saja, belanja di palengke lokal, atau pasar, bisa menjadi pengalaman budaya yang hebat, tetapi bagi banyak warga Filipina, mal lokal adalah tempatnya. Malls telah menggantikan plaza buatan Spanyol sebagai pusat pengumpulan tempat bagi masyarakat, dan mereka menarik baik wisatawan maupun penduduk setempat. Dan di mana lagi Filipinos bisa melarikan diri dari kelembaban yang intens dan angin topan musiman daripada di baik-udara dikondisikan, fasilitas ketat air?

text.sourceText: Local produce sold at the mall

What’s remarkable about these shopping centers in the Philippines is their sheer size. Shoe Mart (SM), the largest shopping mall and retail operator in the Philippines, built Megamall, a 331,679 square-meter (3,570,163 square-foot) mall in the Ortigas Center, in 1991. At that time, it was the largest mall in the country and one of the largest ones in the world. It can accommodate a maximum of 4 million people, and there is even an ice skating rink inside—an attraction that one may not expect in a tropical developing country, where the average income of people is limited. Since then, though, SM NORTH EDSA and SM Mall of Asia have surpassed Megamall in size and popularity.
text.id: Apa yang luar biasa tentang pusat perbelanjaan di Filipina adalah ukuran semata-mata mereka, shoe Mart (SM), pusat perbelanjaan terbesar dan eceran di Filipina, membangun Megamall, sebuah square- meter 331.679 (3,570.163 kaki) mall di Ortigas Center, pada tahun 1991. Pada saat itu, itu adalah mal terbesar di negara ini dan salah satu yang terbesar di dunia. yang dapat mengakomodasi maksimum 4 juta orang, dan bahkan ada arena skating es di dalamnya - atraksi yang mungkin tidak diharapkan di negara berkembang tropis, di mana rata-rata pendapatan orang terbatas. Sejak itu, SM NORTH EDSA dan SM Mall Asia telah melampaui Megamall dalam ukuran dan popularitas.

text.sourceText: Another popular activity among Filipinos is karaoke. You can find karaoke bars, both high-class and makeshift, all over the country. Karaoke sessions are usually part of family gatherings at clubs and even in the local pool hall. Of course, pulutan, or bar food, and lots of beer accompany the karaoke on these occasions. But be mindful, Filipinos take karaoke very seriously, and it should not be seen as mere entertainment. For example, Frank Sinatra’s rendition of “My Way” has become a karaoke standard. If you sing it and don’t render it correctly, habitués of karaoke clubs and other patrons who see themselves as aficionados won’t hesitate to boo or chide you.
text.id: Aktivitas populer lainnya di antara Filipinos adalah karaoke, Anda dapat menemukan bar karaoke, baik kelas tinggi maupun tukang pos, di seluruh negeri, sesi karaoke biasanya bagian dari pertemuan keluarga di klub dan bahkan di aula kolam renang lokal tentu saja, pulu, atau bar food, dan banyak minum bir menemani karaoke pada acara-acara ini. Tapi berhati-hatilah, Filipinos sangat serius, dan tidak boleh dilihat sebagai hiburan.

text.sourceText: Filipinos line dancing for fun and exercise
text.id: Filipinos line dancing for fun and practice

text.sourceText: Dancing is also very popular among Filipinos, and this has been the case since the proliferation of American culture since the early 1900s. Filipinos are known as being among the best dancers in the world, From Latin to ballroom to hip hop, the nation’s top dancers regularly compete in some of the most prestigious international dance competitions, and dance clubs are packed with young Filipinos looking for a good time.
text.id: Dancing juga sangat populer di antara Filipina, dan ini telah terjadi sejak proliferasi budaya Amerika sejak awal 1900-an. Filipinos dikenal sebagai salah satu penari terbaik di dunia, dari Latin ke ballroom untuk hip hop, para penari top bangsa secara teratur bersaing dalam beberapa kompetisi tari internasional yang paling bergengsi, dan klub-klub menari yang dikemas dengan muda Filipinos mencari waktu yang baik.
